front.title: AEQ-Driven Semantic Transport Control for Real-Time Video Agents

abstract.t: This document describes an Agentic Experience Quality (AEQ)-driven semantic transport control framework for real-time video agents using visual tokens. The framework assesses the semantic utility of each visual token by jointly considering its spatial salience and temporal novelty. The AEQ model combines cumulative semantic utility with a normalized transmission-delay cost. Frame-level selection plans the initial token set, while packet-level control continuously adjusts the number of tokens to transmit to maximize predicted AEQ under current network conditions. This document specifies requirements for semantic assessment, transmission modeling, two-level control, and transport feedback.
